summary: Retry the preferred replication route after a successful fallback instead of staying on the fallback until restart.

replay.detail: No replay or history rewrite; route selection is worker-local.

schema.detail: No stored format, table, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: No admission, claim vocabulary, checkpoint or retention changes.

compatibility.detail: After a fallback succeeds, the next exchange after a 60-second cooldown retries the preferred route. Repeated fallback successes do not postpone the retry. Failure resumes existing failover, and Fabric grant-refusal cooldowns remain intact. Wire formats, route ordering and transport status fields are unchanged.

manual.detail: Normal binary upgrade; no configuration or state conversion.

recovery.detail: Transient preferred-route failures no longer require restarting the worker to recover route preference.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no measured downtime or incident-cure claim.
